t: What Does The Name Salifa Mean?
s: In Muslim-majority regions of West Africa-especially in Senegal, Mali, and Guinea-Salifa appears alongside related forms such as Salif (masculine) and Salifa/Salifah (feminine), reflecting a long history of Arabic naming patterns integrated into Mande and Fulani onomastics.
